experiment_scope.formal_claim: Paired worlds share exactly identical decision-visible policy input but have disjoint valid decisive-action sets; therefore a deterministic surface-only policy cannot make a valid decisive action in both worlds.
experiment_scope.empirical_claim: Controlled world-action violation and completion trade-offs for two frozen deterministic decision policies and bounded retrieval/monitor conditions on a procedural synthetic benchmark.
excluded_claims: reliability of arbitrary deployment coverage monitors

paired_surface.action_eval_rule: Exact equality of (action_family, selected_candidate_id) with the hidden world's allowed decisive action set; abstentions are non-decisive.

retrieval.paired_store_control: 11 documents in both A and B; same ordered opaque IDs, same token count in one differently semantic transition slot, all non-slot documents identical
retrieval.truth_firewall: retriever-input separate from scoring-truth; truth joined only after rankings are finalized

primary_comparisons: M3 versus M0 under each policy: jointly report WAVR and completion differences
M3 versus M1 always defer: recovered completion and residual violation risk
M3 versus M4 oracle: diagnostic distance only
M0 P0 and P1: surface-only mechanism realization
primary_reporting.intervals_if_reported: Label only benchmark-resampling; preserve family × ledger-profile weights; never present as real-world sampling uncertainty.
primary_reporting.missing_or_negative_results: Report all preregistered conditions, including zero or harmful outcomes

execution_rules.launch_gate: Separate versioned authorization and exact-sha EXECUTION_REQUEST.json required
execution_rules.exclude_cases: No discretionary exclusions or posthoc removal; implementation failures require documented versioned correction
execution_rules.on_runtime_failure: Preserve failed run and artifacts/logs; never substitute silently changed conditions
execution_rules.post_outcome_changes: Keep original result and source; version correction, rerun all affected conditions, disclose reason
forbid_after_first_outcome: change corpus, family/domain/profile weights or metrics
change monitoring rules or policy behavior
change retriever methods/budgets or model revision
choose favorable strata or suppress null results
